clingen.name: ClinGen gene validity
clingen.description: Expert-curated gene–disease validity classifications, inheritance, and expert panels.
clingen.attribution: Clinical Genome Resource (ClinGen). Gene–Disease Validity classifications; source access date and release are recorded in provenance.json. Converted to indexed gene context with original classification, inheritance and curation links retained. No endorsement is implied.
clingen.coverage: Complete supplied ClinGen gene–disease validity CSV rows with gene, HGNC, MONDO and curation identities. Includes limited, disputed and refuted classifications as well as stronger evidence. Gene context only; no personal disease or allele inference.

orphanet.name: Orphanet rare disease genes
orphanet.description: Rare-disease gene relationships, association types, assessment status, identifiers, and supporting publications.
orphanet.attribution: Orphadata Science: Free access data from Orphanet. © INSERM 1999. Available at https://sciences.orphadata.com/. XML data version is recorded in sourceRelease and provenance.json. Converted and indexed as gene context, retaining original relationship types, assessment status and references. No endorsement is implied.
orphanet.coverage: Complete supplied English Orphadata product 6 disorder–gene relationships with stable disorder, gene and association-type identifiers. Relationships are retained at the source's exact disease/subtype level, without inheritance propagation or inferred genomic alleles.

panelapp.name: PanelApp
panelapp.description: Offline adapter for high-evidence genes on public version 1+ panels; no bundled data pack.
panelapp.license: Genomics England PanelApp content terms; public derived-pack redistribution not established
panelapp.attribution: Genomics England PanelApp and contributing reviewers. The software repository's Apache license does not license PanelApp content. No PanelApp data is redistributed by this preparation tool.
panelapp.reason: UK endpoint returned HTTP 403 during preparation; content terms restrict commercialisation and include third-party data rights. A redistributable source license is required before publishing a static derived pack.

uniprot.name: UniProt curated human variants
uniprot.description: Literature-curated human protein substitutions, source categories, and disease or sample labels linked by rsID.
uniprot.attribution: UniProt Consortium, UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot humsavar. Converted to indexed rsID context; original protein feature identifiers, substitutions and source categories retained. Missing rsID rows are omitted and no genomic allele mapping is invented. No endorsement is implied.
uniprot.coverage: Every supplied humsavar row with a valid dbSNP rsID, including benign and uncertain categories; rows without rsIDs cannot be matched and are counted in provenance. Protein substitutions and disease/sample labels are reference context only: an rsID alone does not confirm the source protein substitution in a user's DNA.
